main_body: Tall brown sack/crate-like bundle with diagonal straps (right, about 10 px wide and 22 px tall), beside a small banded barrel on the left and a cream sack on the right
top_band: Only a 2-3 row orange-brown patch at the very top of the narrow upper part (rows 0-2). It is not a separate lighter surface, and the body below has no distinct top band.
evidence: In a column through the middle of the main body there is a small orange cap at rows 0-2, then a flat brown face with diagonal straps down to row 22. No lighter horizontal surface, front-edge line or eave shadow marks a top. The small barrel on the left has only a 2-3 row lid and no elliptical opening, as in the guide's 'barrel: lid 2px' red example. This is a front elevation or rim-only drawing.

style.evidence: The outlines are dark brown, tinted to the wood, which is good. The large brown body has only about 3-4 tones, with big flat areas of one brown on the main body and the cream sack. Texture is limited to a few grain dots and diagonal strap lines. It is thinner and flatter than the stall and well references, whose tiles carry many more colours.
